name: 3D Voxel Sandbox
agentBrief: A first-person 3D voxel sandbox (Godot 4.6, GDScript only, Forward+, Jolt physics). ENTRY SCENE: res://scenes/main_menu.tscn — the menu boots first and starts the world; scripts/ui/main_menu.gd drives it. WORLD (scripts/world/): the voxel world is chunked — chunk.gd builds a chunk's mesh and chunk_manager.gd streams chunks around the player; voxel_types.gd is the data-driven block registry (add a block type there, not scattered through the code); block_drop.gd spawns pickups when a block breaks; day_night.gd runs the sky cycle, weather.gd the rain/clear states, world_save.gd persists the world. Blocks are addressed by Vector3i cell, 1 block = 1 world unit, a cell's top face is at y + 0.5. PLAYER (scripts/player/): player.gd is a CharacterBody3D with walk/run/jump, mouse look clamped to +/-85 degrees, and a creative-fly toggle on F; a forward RayCast3D with about 6 units of reach picks the targeted block, so left click breaks and right click places on the hit face. inventory.gd holds items, tool_holder.gd and weapon_holder.gd equip from weapon_registry.gd, a STATIC stat table of 42 entries (name, category, damage, attack_speed, mining_power, tier) where each entry resolves to res://assets/models/weapons/<file>.glb — several entries share one model (every maul-family weapon uses warmaul.glb), so adding gear means adding a glb AND a table entry, and nothing scans directories at runtime. The loose *_texture_*.png/.jpg images beside the models are unreferenced duplicates of textures already embedded in the glbs; they stay in the repo for reference but are excluded from the shipped zip (packExclude), so never load them by path. ENTITIES (scripts/entities/): creature.gd is the shared base; animal.gd and fauna.gd are the passive creatures, hostile_mob.gd the aggressive ones. UI (scripts/ui/): hud.gd, minimap.gd, crafting_ui.gd, chest_ui.gd, pause_menu.gd, item_icons.gd and ui_theme.gd (theme it centrally there). CORE (scripts/core/): main.gd is the entry driver, game_state.gd the shared state, advancements.gd the progression hooks, audio_ducker.gd the audio mixing. INPUT: WASD move, mouse look, Space jump or fly up, F toggle fly, 1-5 select block type, left click break, right click place, Esc release the mouse. ASSETS: materials in assets/materials/ are shaders (block_atlas, crack, sky, water, chroma_key); block faces come from the single atlas at assets/textures/blocks/atlas.png, so new block art is an atlas edit plus a voxel_types.gd entry. NOTE: docs/DESIGN.md is behind the code in places — it still describes one node per block and calls the block registry 'planned', but chunked meshing and voxel_types.gd are implemented; trust the scripts. CUSTOMIZE BY: adding block types in voxel_types.gd, retuning player @exports, editing world generation in chunk_manager.gd, adding creatures on creature.gd, reskinning the atlas and models — do not rewrite the chunk streaming or the registry spine.

userFacing.tagline: A first-person voxel world you can mine, build, craft and survive in, ready to make your own.
highlights: First-person controller with walk, run, jump and a creative-fly toggle
Chunked voxel world with streaming, block placing and breaking on a data-driven block registry
Inventory, crafting, chests and block drops
Tools and weapons loaded from folders, so adding gear is a file drop
Passive creatures and hostile mobs on a shared creature base
Day/night cycle, weather and world saving
HUD, minimap, crafting and chest UI, and a themed menu
